prog='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Extend diagonal lines of non-background cells.
    Each line (>=2 same-color cells on a diagonal) extends from its top end
    upward (up-left/up-right) to the grid edge; if the top end is blocked by a
    non-background cell, it extends downward from its bottom end instead.
    An end is not extended if it touches (8-adjacent) another crossing line,
    or if the top end leaves the grid at the edge (no fallback)."""
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lines=[]; seen=set()
    for sgn in (1,-1):
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if (i,j) in seen: continue
                c=g[i][j]
                if c==bg: continue
                cells=[];k=0
                while True:
                    a,b=i+k*sgn,j+k
                    if not(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W) or g[a][b]!=c: break
                    cells.append((a,b));k+=1
                if len(cells)>=2:
                    lines.append((c,cells,sgn)); seen.update(cells)
    def near_other(cell,sgn):
        for c2,cells2,s2 in lines:
            if s2==sgn: continue
            for (a,b) in cells2:
                if max(abs(a-cell[0]),abs(b-cell[1]))==1: return True
        return False
    def fill(start,dvec,c):
        a,b=start[0]+dvec[0],start[1]+dvec[1]
        while 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and g[a][b]==bg:
            g[a][b]=c;a+=dvec[0];b+=dvec[1]
    for c,cells,sgn in lines:
        top,bot=cells[0],cells[-1]
        up=(-sgn,-1); ta,tb=top[0]+up[0],top[1]+up[1]
        if 0<=ta<H and 0<=tb<W:
            if g[ta][tb]==bg and not near_other(top,sgn):

                if 0<=ba<H and 0<=bb<W and g[ba][bb]==bg and not near_other(bot,sgn):
                    fill(bot,d,c)
    return g
